Original, unmodified LineNumberedRichTextBox.cs as provided in the uploaded
CSharpCodeDetective-main source archive (repository: CsmcWzrd/CSharpCodeDetective).

The active build uses the enhanced file at SourceCodeEditor/LineNumberedRichTextBox.cs.
That file retains the upstream RTF-backed RichTextBox and gutter implementation
while adding DPI/zoom and syntax-highlighting fixes.

This original reference file is intentionally NOT compiled. The .csproj includes
only explicit source files to avoid duplicate definitions and autogenerated
assembly metadata from unrelated obj/bin folders.
